slices.title: Denial memory within a run
slices.summary: Within one run, a call the user denied is answered with the typed denial text instead of a new approval when the same call digest was denied earlier in that run. Different arguments still pause, and browser denials still abort. Behind APPROVAL_DENIAL_MEMORY_ENABLED (default false). Soft dependency on WS03.

slices.title: Step-up for never-auto/high-risk
slices.summary: Adds a Control Plane step-up endpoint whose 120 s claim the model-plane token carries. The gateway refuses to grant a step-up-required approval without a fresh claim (typed 403 step_up_required; denials never need one). Enforcement is off, shadow or enforce; v1 may be password-only with shadow for other sign-in methods (K3-22). The chat UI re-authenticates once and retries.

slices.title: Follow-up turns keep Space retrieval authority
slices.summary: Follow-up turns in a Space carry a retrieval decision token, so turn 2 retrieves only inside the Space as turn 1 does. A FORBIDDEN decision on an append yields an empty token and an ungrounded answer, never an org-wide search. The BFF append branch calls the Control retrieval-decision endpoint, and the gateway reads the token from space_context or space_append_context.
slices.flag: GATEWAY_SPACE_APPEND_RETRIEVAL (BFF env): default ON in every environment after the staging proof (K3-18); a kill switch only, where =false re-exposes org documents to shared threads
